title: Document lifecycle (Go kit)
summary: The life of a business document — draft, posted, cancelled, amended — as one set of rules every document module shares: which actions each status allows, a required reason to cancel, amendment numbers (INV-0007-1), the lifecycle columns, and the guarded UPDATE that stops two people posting the same draft.
when_to_use: A module whose documents are posted and then never edited (invoices, orders, receipts, payslips, stock moves).
when_not_to_use: Master data (customers, items) — it is edited and deactivated, never posted.
Multi-step approvals before posting — that is an approvals module; it runs before docstate's post.
